name: single_feedback
implementation: Python standard library only; offline JSON CLI and importable analyze(payload, callback=None)
fixture_provenance: All example and test feedback is synthetic, not client data or measured client outcomes.
scope: Strict closed-schema records with unique IDs and string feedback.
NFKC Unicode normalization, casefolding and whitespace collapse for deduplication and matching.
Configurable literal keyword/phrase themes; omitted themes use performance, support and usability defaults.
Unicode word-boundary matching against normalized feedback; regex metacharacters in keywords are escaped.
Distinct normalized-feedback counts and separate supporting original-record counts per theme.
All original record IDs and verbatim excerpts retained for automatic matches, including duplicates and contradictory feedback.
Unmatched nonempty feedback retains complete source evidence; empty feedback IDs are listed separately.
Explicit empty_feedback, no_themes and no_match statuses, including no_match for individually unmatched themes.
Optional in-process callback for additive span-backed theme assignments and strictly extractive synthesis.
Deterministic sorted output with no timestamps, random values or external calls.

input_contract.root: Object with required records array and optional themes array; unknown fields rejected.
input_contract.record: Exactly {id: string, text: string}. IDs match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}. IDs are unique and case-sensitive.
input_contract.theme: Exactly {id: string, keywords: nonempty array of nonblank strings}. Theme IDs obey the record ID grammar and are unique.
input_contract.empty_themes: An explicitly empty themes array disables automatic categories; nonempty feedback is returned unmatched.
input_contract.blank_records: Allowed but excluded from deduplication and matching; counted and returned by ID.
input_contract.json: Duplicate object keys, NaN, Infinity, unpaired Unicode surrogates, malformed JSON and invalid field types are rejected.
input_contract.cli: python -B implementation.py [UTF-8 input file or -] [--pretty]; omitted input reads stdin. Successful result is JSON on stdout, exit 0. Data/read errors are JSON on stderr, exit 2. argparse usage errors use its standard stderr format.

evidence_contract.offsets: Zero-based Unicode code-point offsets into the ORIGINAL record text; end is exclusive, exactly as Python text[start:end].
evidence_contract.automatic_excerpts: Entire original records are deliberate context-preserving excerpts, not just matched keywords.
evidence_contract.feedback_id: Lexicographically smallest original ID in a normalized duplicate group.
evidence_contract.counts: Theme counts count distinct normalized feedback groups, not customers. Themes can overlap, so theme counts must not be summed as an exclusive total.
evidence_contract.duplicates: Duplicate original IDs remain visible; automatic matches include every original in a duplicate group. Callback-only evidence includes only explicitly supplied spans.
evidence_contract.conflicts: Opposing and negated statements are retained independently, never averaged, discarded or rewritten.

callback_contract.availability: Python API only; no CLI module loading or provider integration.
callback_contract.input: Detached, sorted copy of {records: [{id,text}], themes: [{id,keywords}]}, including empty records and normalized keywords.
callback_contract.output: Exactly {assignments: [{record_id,theme_id,start,end}], syntheses: [{theme_id,text,supports:[{record_id,start,end}]}]}. Both lists are required.
callback_contract.assignments: Additive to keyword matches. IDs must reference supplied records and configured themes; offsets must be actual integers, not booleans, with 0 <= start < end <= source length. Excerpts must be nonblank.
callback_contract.synthesis: Every support must be contained in evidence assigned to the same theme and have a unique source span. Text must exactly equal the ordered supporting excerpts joined with newline characters; unsupported generated prose is rejected.
callback_contract.failure: Invalid callback output, unknown theme or record IDs, missing spans and callback exceptions raise ValidationError. No partial result is returned.
callback_contract.determinism: Guaranteed for fixed input and fixed callback output. Callback execution itself is caller-controlled.

semantic_limits: Keyword matching is not semantic clustering, sentiment analysis, contradiction detection or paraphrase deduplication.
Negation does not cancel a keyword match; full original evidence preserves the opposing view.
Normalization may intentionally merge case, whitespace and compatibility-character variants; punctuation differences remain distinct.
Source validation proves provenance, not semantic appropriateness of a caller-supplied theme assignment.
Extractive synthesis cannot guarantee that selection or ordering is unbiased.
Injected callbacks are trusted local code, not sandboxed, time-limited or inspected for side effects.
No performance benchmark, load/concurrency test, persistent datastore or production-readiness claim is supplied.
Input limits bound data size but do not promise bounded response size, runtime or latency for worst-case theme overlap.
No provider calls, network, installs, agents, repository operations or other-build reuse were used.

coverage_scope: Unmatched input and explicitly empty themes
Valid injected assignment and extractive synthesis
Invalid callback offsets and blank spans
Callback mutation isolation and exception handling
Fabricated synthesis and unassigned support rejection
CLI file input and missing-file failure

measurement.software_build_token_counters: Not collected or inferred here; the parent captures this agent's actual counters.
measurement.client_outcomes: No client outcomes were measured or claimed.
